review.tagline: Local gateway that routes coding agents to the model providers you choose
review.summary: Claude Code Router runs a local gateway on port 3456 that Claude Code, Codex, Grok CLI, Kimi CLI, Kilo Code, OpenCode and other clients point at. Providers, models, credentials and routing rules are managed in an Electron desktop app or an npm CLI with a browser UI. It adds retries, ordered fallbacks, credential pools, request logs with token and cost estimates, and tools such as web search, MCP and ToolHub.
review.audience: Developers using several coding agents who want one provider and routing layer
strengths: One local endpoint for ten named agents, so provider config lives in one place
Retries, key rotation, credential pools and ordered fallback models are built in
Logs show resolved provider, model, latency, tokens and estimated cost per request
Ships as desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux), npm CLI or Docker Compose
weaknesses: Docker script builds against a sibling ../../next-ai/gateway checkout when present
Windows desktop packaging must run on Windows x64 because of native better-sqlite3
Remote exposure needs care; README points to a separate Docker guide for it
Large surface (AgentClaw chat relays, browser automation, plugins) beyond plain routing
needs: Models: OpenAI Chat/Responses, Anthropic Messages, Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek
